be cross verb

also cross, in a huff, angry, tantrum, mad at, I’m mad at you, be mad at

classical

Cic.

stomachor, stomachārī

verb, first conjugation, deponent

be cross, in a huff

Other words

  • suscēnseō, suscēnsēre — be cross with

    verb, second conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 93; Ter.; Cic.; Traupman 103: I’m mad at you, tibi suscēnseō

    + dat.

Examples

  • nihil fēcit quod suscēnseās

    he did nothing for you to be cross aboutTraupman 93; Ter., Cic.

  • Quid stomachāris, mī fīlī?

    What are you cross about, my boy?composed

See also grumpy, irritable, lose one’s temper, happy.

SourcesLewis & Short: stomachor · Lewis & Short: succenseo
